newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Systematic to sell 32 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Systematic to sell 32 pct stake.

text.p: Systematic Education Group Bhd said on Tuesday that its chairman Azmi Wan Hamzah and managing director Yeoh Ah Tu have entered into a pact to sell a 32 percent stake in the firm to a Malay officers' cooperative.
In a statement, the operator of education centres said the price of the stake is 10.53 ringgit per share. The buyer is Koperasi Pegawai-Pegawai Melayu Malaysia Bhd.
Systematic's stock was suspended earlier on Tuesday at the company's request.
According to the company's 1995 annual report, Yeoh and Azmi collectively owned about 41 percent of Systematic's stock, making them the biggest and second biggest shareholders, respectively.
Company officials were not available to comment further on the statement.
A formal agreement will be signed within 14 days, the statement said.
Systematic also requested in a letter to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange that the suspension in the trading of its stock be lifted.
Its shares closed at 12.90 ringgit on Monday.
